name: MultiChoiceAsk
description: Several items from a list, with Select all. Checkboxes are for picking items (R15.4).

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "multi"; options: ChoiceOption[]; min?: number; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The multiple-choice ask: the question, its `options` and `min`, the fewest picks that can be sent (default 1). Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
